Public NACL</font></b></span></div><div style="padding-left: 20px;"><div><ul style="padding-left: 40px;"><li><span><font style="font-size: 11px;"><b>Ingress</b></font></span></li><ul><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">100&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW TCP 443&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;← 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;HTTPS from CloudFront / internet</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">105&nbsp; &nbsp;DENY&nbsp; TCP 3389&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ← 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;block RDP (optional)</font></li><li><span style="background-color: transparent;"><font style="font-size: 11px;">110&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW TCP 1024-65535&nbsp; ← 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;return traffic (NAT GW, ALB)</font></span></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">120&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW ICMP 3/4&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ← 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Path MTU discovery</font></li></ul><li><span><font style="font-size: 11px;"><b>Egress</b></font></span></li><ul style="padding-left: 40px;"><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">100&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW TCP 443&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;→ 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;outbound HTTPS (NAT)</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">110&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW TCP 1024-65535&nbsp; → 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;replies to internet clients and app subnets</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">120&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW ICMP 3/4&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; → 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Path MTU discovery</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">300+n ALLOW TCP 80&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; → app subnets&nbsp; &nbsp;ALB to app</font></li></ul></ul></div><div style="padding-left: 0px;"><span><b><font style="font-size: 11px;">2. App NACL (no rules for efs because it in the same subnet)</font></b></span></div><div><ul style="padding-left: 40px;"><li><span><font style="font-size: 11px;"><b>Ingress</b></font></span></li><ul><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">110&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW TCP 1024-65535&nbsp; ← 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;replies from NAT/internet, endpoints, DB</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">120&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW ICMP 3/4&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ← 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Path MTU discovery</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">300+n ALLOW TCP 80&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ← public subnets&nbsp; ALB to app</font></li></ul><li><span><font style="font-size: 11px;"><b>Egress</b></font></span></li><ul><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">100&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW TCP 443&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;→ 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;HTTPS via NAT / VPC endpoints</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">120&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW ICMP 3/4&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; → 0.0.0.0/0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Path MTU discovery</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">300+n ALLOW TCP 3306&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; → db subnets&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; MySQL</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">310+n ALLOW TCP 1024-65535&nbsp; → public subnets&nbsp; replies to ALB</font></li></ul></ul></div><div><span><b><font style="font-size: 11px;">3. DB NACL</font></b></span></div><div><ul style="padding-left: 40px;"><li><span style="background-color: transparent;"><font style="font-size: 11px;"><b>Ingress</b></font></span></li><ul><li><span style="background-color: transparent;"><font style="font-size: 11px;">120&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW ICMP 3/4&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ← 0.0.0.0/0</font></span></li><li><span style="background-color: transparent;"><font style="font-size: 11px;">300+n ALLOW TCP 3306&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ← app subnets</font></span></li></ul><li><span><font style="font-size: 11px;"><b>Egress</b></font></span></li><ul><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">120&nbsp; &nbsp;ALLOW ICMP 3/4&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; → 0.0.0.0/0</font></li><li><font style="font-size: 11px;">300+n ALLOW TCP 1024-65535&nbsp; → app subnets&nbsp; replies to app tier</font></li></ul></ul></div></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="550" width="618" x="1432" y="550" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> li.span: 100 ALLOW TCP 443 ← 0.0.0.0/0 HTTPS from CloudFront / internet

span.span: 110 ALLOW TCP 1024-65535 ← 0.0.0.0/0 return traffic (NAT GW, ALB)

li.span: 110 ALLOW TCP 1024-65535 → 0.0.0.0/0 replies to internet clients and app subnets
300+n ALLOW TCP 80 → app subnets ALB to app

div.style: padding-left: 0px;

b.span: 2. App NACL (no rules for efs because it in the same subnet)

li.span: 110 ALLOW TCP 1024-65535 ← 0.0.0.0/0 replies from NAT/internet, endpoints, DB
300+n ALLOW TCP 80 ← public subnets ALB to app
100 ALLOW TCP 443 → 0.0.0.0/0 HTTPS via NAT / VPC endpoints
310+n ALLOW TCP 1024-65535 → public subnets replies to ALB
300+n ALLOW TCP 1024-65535 → app subnets replies to app tier
